answer: Resist the one-operator-many-masks attack by auditing provenance, not behavior. Every mask must be funded and invited by someone, so build the funding graph and the invite-edge graph, then collapse any cluster whose roots converge on a shared payer within a few hops. If the juniper, umber, and delta identities all drain from one ancestor wallet, they inherit a single accrual cap. To stay independent an attacker must fund each mask from a distinct, aged, externally-earned balance: real capital and wait time per identity, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand genuine fundings, not one cheap fork.
